targets.baseline_commit_message: audio-transcription: five launch-video transcript readers, moved byte for byte

preserve: only files of the root with a srt, vtt, json or txt extension whose name or display path looks like a transcript are taken
a file is joined to the store by its sha256: the store's alias first, else the 1f: identity of the same hash when the store holds it
a file the store does not hold is listed with origin missing, never dropped
kind is srt, raw, cleaned, rag or transcript-named, read from the display path, else the name
the list is tab-separated kind, ext, origin, identity, bytes, sha256, display_path, and no bytes are read
allowed_deltas: the asset index, the root, the output file and the store are arguments; the store is the files door's answer (--held JSON) or a read-only namespace sqlite copy
the last line is {"result": {files, list, by_kind_and_origin}}
banned_substitutions: a store path or drive written in code
reading file bytes to match them
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
